verdict.rationale: Pylon documents automations (triggers with templates, pylon-docs-30/62) and AI agents with runbooks and skills. It also offers adjacent features: agent simulation testing (pylon-docs-17) and an issue log for inspecting agent outcomes (pylon-docs-19). Nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for triggers, workflows, runbooks, or agent configurations, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
